independent_hammer.interpretation: Four passing tests deliberately prove acceptance gaps; passing does not mean release authorization.

findings.finding: The M1241 source/test/contract are hashed before attempt consumption, but the child source is reopened by pathname after consumption. A concurrent replacement in this gap is not rebound or rejected.
findings.required_fix: Execute an identity-bound immutable child image or otherwise prove that the executed child bytes and dependencies equal the preflight pins. Rehash-only pathname checks do not fully close the race.

findings.finding: The eleven candidate artifacts are only checked for regular-file presence before attempt consumption. Their preflight identities are not frozen and compared with the identities emitted by M1241.
findings.required_fix: Freeze SHA256/size/inode identity for four profiles, four checkpoints, two configs, and the manifest before attempt; require the child receipt candidate_population and manifest identity to match that exact snapshot.

findings.finding: Receipt verification checks only four claim-boundary fields and accepts extra affirmative claims including power_or_energy, paper_metric, and hardware_replay_complete.
findings.required_fix: Validate an exact closed claim-boundary key/value map matching M1241, or explicitly reject every unknown/affirmative authority field.

findings.finding: candidate_id and epoch are checked as independent set membership, so legacy_ep29 paired with epoch 34 is accepted.
findings.required_fix: Validate one of the exact four candidate_id/epoch pairs and bind selected to the matching candidate_population row and minimum-AEE selection rule.
